mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat (room_id, sender_id, message, chat_at, is_read) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{message}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT chat_id AS chatId, room_id AS roomId, sender_id AS senderId, message, chat_at AS chatAt, is_read AS isRead FROM chat WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY chat_id ASC
